about_the_game:
Lilith, daughter of the Darklord, rises to reclaim the stolen crown. Though weak in direct combat, she arms herself with a tower full of traps and slowly advances toward the King’s castle.

Enemies climbing by ladders and jumps impale themselves on hidden spikes or are launched by spring traps, plummeting to the depths below. As they struggle to rise, Lilith’s flintlock pistol ruthlessly stops them in their tracks. With ever-changing battlefields and foes, what traps and items will you use next?

Features

  • Procedurally Generated Worldmap & Stages

    Every run spawns a new tower layout and enemy wave, demanding fresh strategies.

  • Day & Night Cycle

    Build and upgrade traps under cover of night, then fight alongside them by day—stronger enemies lurk with each dawn.

  • Chain Reaction Physics Traps

    Send foes flying, impaled, and falling using ceiling, floor, and wall-mounted traps. Reuse kill zones through creative physics interactions.

  • Item & Skill‑Based Combat

    Combine random items and skills to craft your own lethal playstyle. Boss battles at key checkpoints will put your builds to the test.

  • Darkling Lore

    Uncover the hidden secrets of Lilith’s people as you press on toward the castle. Immerse yourself in a rich narrative brought to life with vibrant animations and cutscenes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Quad Core+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB+ VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Darklord’s Tower is a 2D pixel-art game combining tower-defense, action-platformer, and roguelike elements. Each night, lay traps throughout the Tower, and by day, use your traps and weapons to crush the invading hordes. Only you—the Darklord’s daughter—can reclaim the crown stolen from your father.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
